messages.subject: problem with hosting shiny application
parts: hello, I am Siva Kumar, currently doing my Final year project, which si a  prototype DNA and protein analysis using R..i have done the application using RStudio, and shiny and I am able to deploy my application in ShinyApps I.O...the only problem that i have is that as the shiny server can only run one application per user at any given time, can i upload a few of the same application, with little alteration in the names in the ShinyApps I.O , so many people can use the prototype..and is there any codes for a boot loader that I may use in ShinyApps I.O...i am running the R 3.1.1 on Windows 8.1 and Ubuntu 14.04 LTS...I have am able to build a server as well in the Linux environment, but I am having problems hosting my application..any guidelines and help?

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] problem with hosting shiny application
parts:
Hi Siva,
You should be able to run more than one app per user on shinyapps.io since we actually start up three R processes per application.  That being said, we haven't exposed the fine tuning parameters that would allow you to restrict a single user to a single R process, nor have we surfaced the capability to start up an arbitrary number of R processes.  Today, your best bet on shinyapps.io would be to create N number of apps with different names:  DNAapp01, DNAapp02, DNAapp03,etc....

As for deploying on your own Shiny server install, I would recommend using the support.rstudio.com forum seek help regarding configuration and operation of Shiny Server.

Best,
Tareef
